confirmed_working.name: MaxListCount
confirmed_working.description: Caps the number of entries returned; 0 triggers a metadata-only response.

confirmed_working.name: ListStartOffset
confirmed_working.description: Pagination offset into the phonebook; verified zero overlap across sequential pages.

confirmed_working.name: Format
confirmed_working.description: Selects the vCard version used to encode returned contact entries.

confirmed_working.name: PBAPSupportedFeatures
confirmed_working.description: Client capability declaration sent at CONNECT; must include Download+DatabaseIdentifier+FolderVersionCounters bits to unlock version/database metadata in later responses.

confirmed_working.name: PhonebookSize
confirmed_working.description: Response-only field; total contact count in the requested phonebook.

confirmed_working.name: PrimaryVersionCounter
confirmed_working.operation: PullPhoneBook response (requires PBAPSupportedFeatures bit 0x08 at CONNECT)
confirmed_working.description: Response-only monotonic counter; verified to increment by 1 after a real contact was added.

confirmed_working.name: SecondaryVersionCounter
confirmed_working.operation: PullPhoneBook response (requires PBAPSupportedFeatures bit 0x08 at CONNECT)
confirmed_working.description: Response-only counter; observed moving in lockstep with PrimaryVersionCounter in all tests.

confirmed_working.name: DatabaseIdentifier
confirmed_working.operation: PullPhoneBook response (requires PBAPSupportedFeatures bit 0x04 at CONNECT)
confirmed_working.description: Response-only fixed identifier for the phone's contacts database instance; verified stable across a Bluetooth radio toggle/reconnect.

confirmed_working.name: PropertySelector
confirmed_working.description: Selects which vCard fields the server includes; clearing bit3 (PHOTO) reduced a 400,748-byte pull to 17,906 bytes.

confirmed_working.name: Order
confirmed_working.description: Server-side sort order for the vCard listing; verified 0x01 returns genuinely different ordering than 0x00.

confirmed_working.name: SearchValue
confirmed_working.description: Search string for server-side filtering; paired with SearchAttribute.

confirmed_working.name: SearchAttribute
confirmed_working.description: Selects which field SearchValue matches against; verified server-side filter to a single exact-match contact.

confirmed_working.name: MaxListCount
confirmed_working.description: Caps the number of message entries returned; 0 triggers a metadata-only response.

confirmed_working.name: ListStartOffset
confirmed_working.description: Pagination offset into the message listing.

confirmed_working.name: FilterReadStatus
confirmed_working.description: Server-side read/unread filter; verified narrowed 10 messages to the 1 genuinely unread one.

confirmed_working.name: ParameterMask
confirmed_working.description: Selects which listing fields the server includes; verified requesting only subject+type dropped datetime/sender_name/etc. from the response.

confirmed_working.name: MessagesListingSize
confirmed_working.description: Response-only total message count for the current folder; verified matches the real inbox contents (10).

confirmed_working.name: NewMessage
confirmed_working.description: Response-only flag; 1 if the folder has at least one new/unread message.

confirmed_working.name: MSETime
confirmed_working.description: Response-only field; the phone's current local date/time.

confirmed_working.name: StatusIndicator
confirmed_working.description: Selects which status property to update; verified byte-correct against BlueZ obexd and AOSP MAP client source, not live-fired.

confirmed_working.name: StatusValue
confirmed_working.description: New value for the property selected by StatusIndicator; verified byte-correct against BlueZ obexd and AOSP MAP client source, not live-fired.
